Name: Hat Mouse Displays
Author: Draylon
Description:
This Adds Little Displays around the Hat Mouse Area, showcasing all the hats you can get.
The hats rotate so you can see them from all angles (and uses the player wearing animation so thats what it will look like on you!)
You can click on the Displays to see what you will need to do to unlock that specific hat.


I wish I could have had them only show up once you've unlocked them, but it doesn't seem to be possible with the current non-coding tools available to me

~~~Compatibility.~~~
Vanilla version does an edit to the farm map to push out the cliff to make space, so any other mod that edits that area might have issues with them trying to override each other. (However I do not touch the House at All, so mods that fix up the house should still work fine.

Should Be compatible with SVE, but the Below restrictions still apply.

With how I had to write it, if you have a mod that replaces one of the Hat Mouse Hats, it won't show the new modded Hat on the display,  because maps can't call from the source file, so i made my own version that the map is using.

It will also not create a stand for any new hat that is added by mods, I would have to do that manually.
